info.title: Bee: Quantum Intelligence - Developer API
info.description: OpenAI-compatible developer API for Bee: Quantum Intelligence. API keys are created in Bee Workspace and sent as Bearer credentials.

get.summary: List Bee model aliases and immutable snapshots
List Bee models staged for OpenRouter provider integration
get.description: Provider-facing catalog with per-token prices, modalities, features, capacity, datacenters, and explicit staged/ready launch state.

403.description: The requested model or capability is not included

post.summary: Run a Bee Code software-development turn
post.description: Versioned, structured NDJSON agent protocol for local IDE, CLI, and API clients. Tool calls, file deltas, approvals, progress, completion, and failure are machine events rather than assistant prose.

run_id.description: Stable durable run identifier across every manager/tool cycle for one customer task.

effort.description: Optional product effort level; omitted keeps the plane's default output budget.

enable_thinking.description: Enable the selected model's explicit thinking mode. Requests are rejected when the model does not support it.

client_tools.description: Bounded tools registered in the calling VS Code host, including MCP tools. Every invocation remains locally validated and approval-gated.

402.description: Hard plan allowance reached; upgrade required

403.description: Model, scope, or authorised-security requirement denied

503.description: Entitled runtime or durable run store unavailable

post.summary: Validate a governed computer-use host report
post.description: Validates a bee.computer.v1 host report and optional approved action request. The API does not perform desktop input; execution remains on the real local host that holds OS permissions.

400.description: Invalid host report, action request, or approval class

get.summary: Inspect one authenticated Bee agent run

200.description: Account-scoped run status and bounded usage

404.description: Run not found for this account

delete.summary: Cancel one running authenticated Bee agent run

404.description: Run not found for this account

post.summary: Execute the Bee Code web_search tool
post.description: Registry-driven live web search for the bee.code.v1 agent plane. The client executes the model's web_search tool call by POSTing here with its turn credential.

200.description: Provider used and titled results with URLs and snippets

503.description: No search provider configured on this deployment

post.summary: Transcribe Bee Code mic audio to text
post.description: Multipart audio upload transcribed over the governed ASR provider chain; powers the editor composer's dictation input.

200.description: Transcribed text with provider and model

503.description: No ASR provider configured on this deployment

post.summary: Submit authenticated feedback for a Bee interaction

403.description: RAG is not enabled for this plan

post.summary: Add a tenant-scoped text document for retrieval
Retrieve relevant chunks from the caller's documents

get.summary: List the caller's personal memory records
List tenant-scoped Quantum Reasoning Lab jobs and capabilities

200.description: Job summaries, pagination cursor, and current model/QPU capabilities

post.summary: Create a durable Quantum Reasoning Lab job

200.description: Existing job returned for the same idempotency key and request

409.description: Idempotency key was reused with different input

get.summary: Get candidates, selection evidence, result, usage, and receipt for one job

404.description: Job not found in the authenticated tenant

delete.summary: Cancel a queued job or erase terminal-job content while retaining audit metadata

409.description: Execution started and cancellation is no longer safe

post.summary: Use the hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server
post.description: JSON-RPC MCP transport. OAuth protected resource metadata is available at /oauth/protected-resource.

401.description: OAuth or Bee API key required

get.summary: Get account, billing-period usage, allowances, and usage breakdown
Verify one agentic coding session's ML-DSA-65-signed provenance chain
get.description: Caller-scoped. Returns only digests, never code. Re-verify offline with any FIPS 204 verifier.

200.description: Chain, verdict, and SPKI public key

get.summary: List or fetch encrypted Bee Code session history
get.description: API keys need the code:sessions:read scope. Rate limited to 60 requests per minute.

200.description: Up to 100 items; record included only when id is given

401.description: Missing or invalid API credential, or missing session scope

put.summary: Write or tombstone one Bee Code session record
put.description: API keys need the code:sessions:write scope. Uses optimistic revision fencing.

401.description: Missing or invalid API credential, or missing session scope

post.summary: Use the A2A 1.0 JSONRPC agent interface
post.description: Discovery at /.well-known/agent-card.json. Methods: SendMessage, GetTask, CancelTask, ListTasks, CreateTaskPushNotificationConfig, GetTaskPushNotificationConfig, ListTaskPushNotificationConfigs, DeleteTaskPushNotificationConfig, GetExtendedAgentCard, SendStreamingMessage, SubscribeToTask. JSON-RPC errors other than authentication return HTTP 200.

200.description: JSON-RPC response, or an SSE stream of JSON-RPC frames ending with [DONE] for streaming methods

get.description: Does not wake or probe any inference lane.
